title: Dragon Diner in Stasis
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a massive, winding stone dragon bridge with glowing crystals extending from a fantasy castle below toward a wooden platform in the stars. On the platform sits a colorful circus tent labeled 'Dragon Diner - Stasis Served Hot' beside a large windmill, with a purple dragon coiled on the deck and a witch flying on a broom along a glowing path lined with red lanterns.
